scripts.android:apk: cd mobile && npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:release: cd mobile && npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:open: cd mobile && npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xed ios
scripts.phone: cd mobile && npx expo run:android --variant release
scripts.phone:logs: adb logcat -v time -s ReactNativeJS:* ReactNative:* AndroidRuntime:E
